provenance.export_rule: The JAR is owned, Mojang-copyrighted material: it is referenced by hash only and must never be copied into the repo, the public export, a release package or the :8099 gallery.

launch.cwd: a fresh per-run directory containing ONLY tools/mp_fixture/server.properties (plus the pinned settled world, see world)
launch.stdin: must stay OPEN (e.g. `tail -f cmds.txt | java ...`); commands are appended to cmds.txt. A closed stdin is the known Beta-server EOF spin trap.
launch.graceful_stop: append `save-all` then `stop` to cmds.txt; never kill by image name, only the PID this run started
launch.note: REL-14a's own probe used -Xmx512M and got the vanilla '**** NOT ENOUGH RAM!' warning; the pinned argv uses the size the server itself asks for.

properties.rewritten_check: sha256 identical before and after the 2026-10-18 probe run (every key the server reads is present, so PropertyManager never re-saves it)
properties.server_port_reason: 25565 is held by the Poseidon host (PID-owned by the lead's rig); the vanilla fixture listens on 25570 so both can coexist. MP endpoint for runs: 192.0.2.27:25570.
properties.level_seed_reason: same seed as the mc173-diag fixture the mp_play route was scouted on (mp_play_core.h:93); vanilla's spawn search lands elsewhere (probe: spawn 3,64,-39; player 1.5,65.62,-32.5), so the route is NOT pre-scouted on this fixture
properties.difficulty: spawn-monsters=true -> difficultySetting 1 (Easy). Vanilla Beta 1.7.3 can only express 0 or 1 (MinecraftServer.java:177); difficulty 2 cannot be pinned on a vanilla server
properties.view_distance_reason: matches the Poseidon fixture the Wii LAN walk was proven against (vanilla default is 10)
properties.ops: none (ops.txt absent/empty): the device is a normal non-op player
